page.overview:
Who is Horm Akerspaark?

Horm was one of King Akerspaark's five legitimate sons, his brothers were Orm, Gorm, Torm, and Gonzalez. He also had six sisters: Alia, Valia, Nina, Paulina, Malvina, and Argentina.

In , he participated in the Toussaint Knights' Tourney, his fourth year competing.
